global_restrictions: ABSOLUTELY NO MAPS of any kind (no Leaflet, no Google Maps, no Mapbox, no SVG geographic maps).
ABSOLUTELY NO SOCIAL MEDIA ICONS anywhere (no Twitter, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube).
Address in Contact and Footer must be clean formatted text only with pin code and landmark.
Footer is dark navy/violet with logo, tagline, quick links, legal, support, contact info, text address, security certifications, and copyright.
Use REAL DSC USB token hardware photos (no generic vector/clipart illustration placeholders).
Every interactive element and key stat/status MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.

marketing_public_site.header: Clean sticky navigation bar with SimplDSC Hexagon Logo, nav links (Products, Use Cases, DSC Finder, Pricing, About, Resources, Contact), Phone/Support badge, Login/OTP button, and primary CTA 'Get Your DSC'.
marketing_public_site.hero_section: Headline 'Your Trusted Digital Signature Partner in India', eyebrow 'CCA COMPLIANT & PAPERLESS E-KYC', subtitle 'Legally valid Class 3 & DGFT Digital Signatures delivered in 24 hours. Sign MCA, GST, Income Tax & e-Tenders effortlessly.', two CTA buttons ('Get Your DSC Now', 'Find My DSC Wizard'), trust metric counter chips (150,000+ DSCs issued, 99.8% Approval, 2-Hour eKYC, 100% Legal IT Act 2000), real USB token hardware photograph card with floating security check chip.
marketing_public_site.trust_bar: Certifying Authorities logos & compliance pills: eMudhra, Capricorn, VSign, IDSign, CCA Licensed, FIPS 140-2 Level 2 Token, SHA-256 / 2048-Bit RSA.
marketing_public_site.dsc_finder_wizard: Interactive 3-step decision tree ('Which DSC Do You Need?'): Step 1: Who are you? (Individual, Business Entity, Foreign National, Exporter/Importer). Step 2: What is your primary portal/use-case? (Income Tax/GST, MCA/ROC Filings, eTendering/GeM, DGFT/ICEGATE, High-volume PDF Signing). Step 3: Token preference (New Token + Certificate, Renewal / Existing Token only, Cloud Sign). Instant recommendation card with price, validity, documents required, and 'Buy This DSC' direct link.
marketing_public_site.use_cases_bento: 6 asymmetric cards: Income Tax & GST Returns, MCA-21 & ROC Company Incorporation, e-Tendering & GeM Government Contracts, DGFT & Foreign Trade IEC, Trademark & Patent Filings, Banking & Document Signer.
marketing_public_site.products_grid: Tabs: All, Individual, Organization, DGFT / Foreign Trade, Document Signer. Each card features real USB token photo, Class badge, Validity pill (1 Yr / 2 Yrs / 3 Yrs), encryption type (Signing Only / Combo Sign & Encrypt), included FIPS token details, transparent price in INR with GST note, bullet features, and 'Select & Order' button.
marketing_public_site.how_it_works_steps: 4 clear numbered steps: 1. Choose DSC & Duration, 2. Paperless Video eKYC / Aadhaar OTP, 3. CA Verification & Issuance (under 2 hours), 4. Express Dispatch of Cryptographic Token or Instant Download.
marketing_public_site.pricing_comparison: Clear tiered comparison with toggle for 1 Year / 2 Years / 3 Years. Clear breakdown of Individual vs Organization vs DGFT vs Bulk Signer.
marketing_public_site.footer: Deep navy background (#070D1C), brand logo with purple hexagon, text description, quick links, legal links, support hours, full physical corporate address (NO map), support email and phone, compliance disclaimer 'SimplDSC operates as an authorized registration authority partner for CCA licensed Certifying Authorities. No social media icons.'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact navy/violet/lavender design system. Maintain a high-end fintech & compliance look that exudes security, trust, and speed.
Strictly honor the two global restrictions: ZERO maps of any kind and ZERO social media icons across all components, footers, headers, and contact pages.
Use the real DSC token photos provided in `image_urls` for the hero and product cards. Make them prominent with crisp card borders and subtle elevation.
Implement the DSC Finder as an interactive wizard that guides users based on their need (e.g. Individual vs Director vs Exporter vs Contractor) and auto-selects the recommended product.
Implement the customer auth flow using Indian phone number + OTP (simulated with instant 4-digit/6-digit prefill for effortless testing).
Implement the interactive purchase modal with Razorpay checkout experience, address capture for USB token shipping, and instant order creation.
Provide rich customer dashboard views (My Orders with visual timeline, My DSCs with expiry warnings, Pending Document uploads, Invoices download, Ticket creation).
Provide comprehensive Admin dashboard with tabbed management: Orders, KYC Document Verification, Issued DSCs, Enquiry Leads, Coupons, and Staff/CA stats.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, status badges, and table rows for testing.
